baseline.change: Only document preparation and the run protocol change. Corpus, queries, judgments, model, upstream, dimensions, query instruction, numeric gates and budgets are identical to v1.

provider.name: openrouter
provider.routing_rationale: One upstream so vectors never mix: DeepInfra serves the full 32,768-token context at the lowest listed price (Nebius lists 32,000; SiliconFlow is fp8 at 4x the price). Listing retrieved 2026-09-23.

preparation.document: Plain text. Tip: title, blank line, body. Review: body.
preparation.query_instruction:
Instruct: Given a web search query, retrieve relevant passages that answer the query
Query:
preparation.over_limit: No truncation. A document over document_max_bytes UTF-8 bytes, or not valid UTF-8, blocks the run before any HTTP request.
preparation.token_bound: At most one token per UTF-8 byte plus 8 special tokens per input: 30,008 tokens for the largest allowed document, inside the 32,768-token model and endpoint context. This bounds this corpus only; it is not a guarantee for future inputs.
preparation.long_input_reference: Each cohort document is embedded a second time from its full text as the reference, even though the prepared text is now identical, so the v1 long-input comparison keeps its five documents.

protocol.real_command: TIPS_REAL_PROVIDERS=1 unbuffer mix run scripts/search_probe.exs --real --gate v2 --output test/fixtures/search_probe/evidence/v2-run-1.json
protocol.evidence_output: evidence/v2-run-1.json; the probe refuses to overwrite an existing report.
protocol.request_order: Endpoint listing, key check, the 40 eligible documents in corpus order, the 5 cohort references in cohort order, then three passes over the ten queries in query order.
protocol.dimensions: Request 1024 dimensions. A 1024- or 4096-value first response settles the length; any later length is an error.
protocol.on_error: Stop at a failed preflight or the first provider error, including an HTTP 400 for dimensions, and write the report with every attempt kept.
